Question 1
?

A part of the graph of a polynomial p(x) is given above. Which of the following statements is true?

a
x=−7 is a multiple root of odd multiplicity
b
x=−7 is not a root of p(x)
c
x=−7 is a simple root
d
x=−7 is a multiple root of even multiplicity
e
x=−7 is a simple root of even multiplicity
